messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate observed from control-plane -> auth-proxy (region-us-west) — alerting SRE oncall. Links: https://grafana.example/r/controlplane-5xx /runbook/auth-proxy-rate-window

emma (oncall_sre): on it. seeing a sharp spike in auth-proxy 502/504s and a timeout tail. starting triage.

emma (oncall_sre): quick customer impact summary: ~8% of hosted API requests are returning 5xx in us-west, latency p99 up from 180ms to 2.1s. No signed SLA breaches yet but trends look bad.

michael (eng-runtime): adding context — we pushed auth-proxy 1.7.2 yesterday that changed the rate-window logic for org-lookup fanout. possible regression.

lisa (platform): telemetry shows org-lookup backend (config-store) experienced increased latencies ~09:12 UTC, coincident with spike.

emma (oncall_sre): reproduction: curl against gateway shows intermittent 502s. grabbing logs now.

emma (oncall_sre): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:13:02Z auth-proxy ERROR request failing: upstream timeout after 1200ms id=ab12 src=gw-prod-3
2026-03-15T09:13:03Z auth-proxy WARN rate-window exceeded for tenant=redwood-internal
```

michael (eng-runtime): ok can we flip the rate-window back to previous thresholds as a mitigation? that's low-risk config.

emma (oncall_sre): preparing quick rollback of rate-window toggle via featureflag. pinging platform for safe deploy.

lisa (platform): I can stage the flag flip to Canary first. pushing CLI command: `platformctl feature set auth-proxy.rate_window_mode previous --env=prod --region=us-west --canary=10%`

emma (oncall_sre): execute when ready. I want to monitor p50/p99 and 5xx curve.

lisa (platform): executing now. will update once canary completes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: deployment event: feature-toggle update started by lisa at 09:17 UTC — canary target 10%

lisa (platform): canary green after 60s. increasing to 50%.

emma (oncall_sre): p99 dropped from 2.1s to 650ms on canary nodes, 5xx rate reduced on that slice.

lisa (platform): scaling to 100% now.

incident-bot: deployment event: feature-toggle rollout to 100% completed at 09:21 UTC

emma (oncall_sre): immediate improvement across region. global 5xx rate back to ~1.2%. still slightly elevated vs baseline.

michael (eng-runtime): I want to cut a quick hotfix to revert the rate-window algorithm change in 1.7.3 branch — will open PR and attach to postmortem.

emma (oncall_sre): agreed. for now mitigation is applied. starting mitigation -> monitoring phase.

emma (oncall_sre): handoff note to next oncall (raj): please continue watch for regressions, check related downstream services (billing, org-lookup, config-store) for slow tails, validate no regression in other regions.

raj (oncall_next): taking over. thanks for the context. I'll run the usual checklists and set a 30m watch.

emma (oncall_sre): key diagnostics attached: query of request traces showing most 5xx had >1 remote call to org-lookup that timed out; sampling ids: [trace-7c1, trace-7c4, trace-7d0].

michael (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://git.example/rw/auth-proxy/pulls/432 — revert rate-window change, unit tests + integration run queued. tagging lisa for deploy ops.

lisa (platform): noted. will coordinate safe rollout to prod after QA.

raj (oncall_next): also enabling a temporary defensive fallback in gateway: `gateway.cfg upstream_timeout=2000ms fallback_to_readonly=true` to reduce cascading failures for the next hour.

emma (oncall_sre): good call. set alert to escalate if 5xx > 3% for 10m.

sre-bot: Alert set: control-plane-5xx-escalate threshold=3% duration=10m; notify @pagerduty/escalation

raj (oncall_next): customer-impact note for ops: several heavy tenants saw failed requests for metadata endpoints; internal monitoring shows retries recovered many requests, but some user-facing errors persisted for ~8-12 minutes pre-mitigation.

emma (oncall_sre): leaving a short incident summary for postmortem: cause = rate-window regression in auth-proxy -> amplified org-lookup latencies -> gateway 502s; mitigation = feature-flag rollback + gateway defensive fallback; next actions = hotfix PR, enhanced canary, add longer timeouts to org-lookup circuit breaker, add synthetic check for org-lookup latency in us-west.

michael (eng-runtime): will own the hotfix and tests. targeting patch deploy tomorrow morning.

lisa (platform): I'll add a runbook step for quicker feature-flag rollbacks and a dashboard panel for the rate-window metric.

raj (oncall_next): I'm on 30m watch. will escalate to on-call manager if 5xx rises again. :thumbsup:

emma (oncall_sre): handing off fully — thanks team. leaving thread. :eyes:
_meta: generated for dataset: incident coordination thread about control-plane auth-proxy rate window causing 5xx spike
